response.sql: WITH r AS (SELECT d.A3 AS region, AVG(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS avg_signed, COUNT(*) AS txn_count FROM trans t JOIN account a ON t.account_id = a.account_id JOIN district d ON a.district_id = d.district_id WHERE t.date >= '1996-05-09' AND t.date <= '1998-01-06' GROUP BY d.A3), o AS (SELECT AVG(avg_signed) AS overall_avg FROM r) SELECT r.region, r.avg_signed, r.txn_count, r.avg_signed / o.overall_avg AS ratio FROM r CROSS JOIN o WHERE o.overall_avg IS NOT NULL
